newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$11 bln NCDs on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$11 bln NCDs on Monday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Monday it would issue T$11 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 11:15 local time (0315 GMT), a central bank official said.
The issue coincides with a long bull run in Taiwan's stock market, where the index has pushed to a series of seven-year highs in recent weeks on record-breaking turnover.
Monday was no exception. The index opened up 143.69 points or 1.47 percent at 9,892.99, a seven-year intraday high.

Central bank chief Sheu Yuan-dong said on Wednesday the bank would not adjust monetary policy merely to cool Taiwan's red-hot stock market, saying such moves were no "cure all" in the face of concerns of overheating.

But the central bank's repeated issuance of NCDs has been seen widely as a bid to dampen the sizzling stock market by slowing what have been huge flows of liquidity out of the money market and into the bourse.
